FIBA AmeriCup|2025 Managua]]|}} }} '''João Marcello Cardoso Pereira''' (born 28 August 2000),{{cite web|title=João Marcello Cardoso Pereira|url=https://lnb.com.br/atletas/joao-marcello-cardoso-pereira/|website=LNB.com.br|access-date=21 March 2024}} commonly known as '''Mãozinha Pereira''', or simply '''Mãozinha''', is a Brazilian professional [[basketball]] player for [[Paris Basketball]] of the [[LNB Élite]] and the [[EuroLeague]]. ==Professional career== Mãozinha began his career with [[Esporte Clube Pinheiros (basketball)|Pinheiros]] of the [[Novo Basquete Brasil]], where he played 4 games{{cite web|title=Maozinha Pereira Player Profile|url=https://basketball.realgm.com/player/Maozinha-Pereira/Summary/120100|website=RealGM.com|access-date=21 March 2024}} before signing with [[KK Crn Drim|Crn Drim]] of the [[Macedonian First League (basketball)|Macedonian First League]] where he averaged 13.1 points and 8.1 rebounds. ===Cearense (2021–2022)=== On 12 August 2021, Mãozinha signed with [[Associação de Basquete Cearense|Cearense]] of the [[Novo Basquete Brasil]]{{cite web|title=Fortaleza Basquete Cearense oficializa a contratação do ala/pivô, Mãozinha, ex-atleta do Esporte Clube Pinheiros|url=https://fortaleza1918.com.br/fortaleza-basquete-cearense-oficializa-a-contratacao-do-ala-pivo-maozinha-ex-atleta-do-esporte-clube-pinheiros/|website=Fortaleza1918.com.br|date=12 August 2021|access-date=23 March 2024|language=Portuguese}} where he averaged 13.5 points, 9.6 rebounds, 1.1 assists and 1.3 steals. ===Corinthians (2022–2023)=== After going undrafted in the [[2022 NBA draft]], Mãozinha played the 2022–2023 season for [[Sport Club Corinthians Paulista (basketball)|Corinthians]] of the [[Novo Basquete Brasil]],{{cite web|title=Fortaleza Basquete Cearense oficializa a contratação do ala/pivô, Mãozinha, ex-atleta do Esporte Clube Pinheiros|url=https://www.corinthians.com.br/noticias/maozinha-anunciado-corinthians-basquete-temporada-2022-2023|website=Corinthians.com.br|date=15 June 2022|access-date=23 March 2024|language=Portuguese}} where he averaged 11.2 points, 9.8 rebounds, and 1.2 blocks. ===Mexico City Capitanes (2023–2024)=== On 30 October 2023, Mãozinha joined the [[Mexico City Capitanes]] of the [[NBA G League]]{{cite tweet|author=CAPITANES|title=#SomosCapitanes|number=1719057281759793484|user=CapitanesCDMX|date=30 October 2023|access-date=19 March 2024|language=Spanish}} and on 12 January 2024, he scored a career-high 19 points along with 11 rebounds, 3 steals, and 3 blocks against the [[Wisconsin Herd]].{{cite web|title=Mexico City's Fourth Quarter Comeback Stifles The Herd|url=https://gleague.nba.com/game/wis-vs-mxc-2022300098?view=game-story|website=NBA.com|date=12 January 2024|access-date=19 March 2024}} On 31 January, he was selected for the G League dunk contest, finishing in third place.{{cite web|first=Carlos|last=Bernal|title=How did the Mexican representatives do at the NBA All-Star Weekend?|url=https://www.vavel.com/en-us/nba/2024/02/20/1173159-how-did-the-mexican-representatives-do-at-the-nba-all-star-weekend.html|website=Vavel.com|date=20 February 2024|access-date=19 March 2024}} ===Memphis Grizzlies (2024)=== On 20 March 2024, Mãozinha signed a 10-day contract with the [[Memphis Grizzlies]].{{cite web|title=Grizzlies sign Dejon Jarreau and Maozinha Pereira to 10-day contracts|url=https://www.nba.com/grizzlies/news/grizzlies-sign-dejon-jarreau-and-maozinha-pereira-to-10-day-contracts|website=NBA.com|date=20 March 2024|access-date=20 March 2024}} He had just over five minutes on the court and scored two points in his NBA debut, a 137–116 loss to the [[Golden State Warriors]], becoming the 20th Brazilian to play in the NBA.{{cite web|title=Mãozinha faz linda ponte aérea em sua estreia na NBA e encontra Gui Santos; veja|url=https://ge.globo.com/basquete/nba/noticia/2024/03/21/maozinha-faz-linda-ponte-aerea-em-sua-estreia-na-nba-e-encontra-gui-santos-veja.ghtml|website=Globo.com|date=21 March 2024|access-date=22 March 2024|language=Portuguese}} On 30 March, he signed a second 10-day contract with the Grizzlies.{{cite web|title=Grizzlies sign Maozinha Pereira and Zavier Simpson to 10-day contracts|url=https://www.nba.com/grizzlies/news/grizzlies-sign-maozinha-pereira-and-zavier-simpson-to-10-day-contracts|website=NBA.com|date=30 March 2024|access-date=30 March 2024}} ===Memphis Hustle (2024–2025)=== On 6 September 2024, Mãozinha re-signed with the Grizzlies,{{cite web|title=Grizzlies sign Armando Bacot, Yuki Kawamura, Miye Oni and Maozinha Pereira|url=https://www.nba.com/grizzlies/news/grizzlies-sign-armando-bacot-yuki-kawamura-miye-oni-and-maozinha-pereira|website=NBA.com|date=6 September 2024|access-date=6 September 2024}} but was waived on 19 October.{{cite web|first=Luke|last=Adams|title=Grizzlies Cut Four Camp Invitees|url=https://www.hoopsrumors.com/2024/10/grizzlies-cut-four-camp-invitees.html|website=HoopsRumors.com|date=19 October 2024|access-date=21 October 2024}} On 28 October, he joined the [[Memphis Hustle]].{{cite web|title=Memphis Hustle announce 2024–25 Training Camp Roster|url=https://memphis.gleague.nba.com/news/memphis-hustle-announce-2024-25-training-camp-roster|website=NBA.com|date=28 October 2024|access-date=28 October 2024}} ===Manisa Basket (2025–2026)=== On July 25, 2025, he signed with [[Manisa Basket]] of the [[Basketbol Süper Ligi]] (BSL).{{Cite tweet |user=manisabasket94
